purpose: Native ChatSession selection-ceiling comparison before T1 or changed retrieval
selected_sources: Same eligible SQL episode units in every presentation; frozen discovery seam; no Qdrant selection claim

review.mechanics: Every case must finish without error/truncation and admit the same original IDs across presentations. Failure is a separate mechanical gate, not a model-quality result.
review.semantics: Review complete native visible responses against all offline expected clauses; flag unsupported recall facts, proposed-to-decided promotion, loss of deliberate ambiguity, wrong current task, or ignored current-author override.
review.candidate_screen: No semantic failures in this small development corpus before advancing to generated-aid experiments. Passing is not a held-out/general quality claim.

cost_exclusions: complete generation usage if reasoning is stripped
stop: If original-only native candidates remain unreliable, leave T1/T2/default-on blocked and report the capability boundary. Do not tune a new held-out set.
